worked.problem: A sphere has radius 3 cm. Find its volume and exposed surface area in terms of π.
actions: Mark radius 3 cm from the centre of the sphere to its surface.
Use V = (4/3)πr³ and SA = 4πr². The surface is one continuous exposed boundary.
Volume = (4/3)π(3)³ = 36π cm³.
Exposed surface area = 4π(3)² = 36π cm².
Answer: V = 36π cm³; exposed SA = 36π cm². Check the volume uses a cube and the surface area uses a square.
worked.check: Answer: V = 36π cm³; exposed SA = 36π cm². Check the volume uses a cube and the surface area uses a square.

worked.problem: A closed right cone has radius 4 cm and perpendicular height 3 cm. Find its slant height, volume and total exposed surface area in terms of π.
actions: Draw the right cone. Mark base radius 4 cm and perpendicular height 3 cm from apex to centre.
Use a right triangle to find the slant height: √(4² + 3²) = 5 cm. This is the curved-side length.
Volume = (1/3)π(4)²(3) = 16π cm³.
Exposed surface area = π(4)(5) + π(4)² = 36π cm², including the closed base.
Answer: V = 16π cm³; exposed SA = 36π cm²; slant height = 5 cm. Check the perpendicular height was used for volume.
worked.check: Answer: V = 16π cm³; exposed SA = 36π cm²; slant height = 5 cm. Check the perpendicular height was used for volume.

Use a right triangle to find the slant height: √(35² + 84²) = 91 cm. This is the curved-side length.
Exposed surface area = π(35)(91) + π(35)² = 4410π cm², including the closed base.
Answer: V = 34300π cm³; exposed SA = 4410π cm²; slant height = 91 cm. Check the perpendicular height was used for volume.

This is the curved-side length. Volume = (1/3)π(35)²(84) = 34300π cm³. Exposed surface area = π(35)(91) + π(35)² = 4410π cm², including the closed base. Answer: V = 34300π cm³; exposed SA = 4410π cm²; slant height = 91 cm. Check the perpendicular height was used for volume.

mastery.prompt: A sphere has radius 37 cm. Find its volume and exposed surface area in terms of π.
actions: Mark radius 37 cm from the centre of the sphere to its surface.
Use V = (4/3)πr³ and SA = 4πr². The surface is one continuous exposed boundary.
Exposed surface area = 4π(37)² = 5476π cm².
Answer: V = (202612/3)π cm³; exposed SA = 5476π cm². Check the volume uses a cube and the surface area uses a square.
